concerns.text: FR-007 specifies different underlying predictive models for each UQ technique (GPR uses GaussianProcessRegressor, MC‑Dropout and Deep Ensembles use a small MLP, Conformal Prediction uses XGBoost). This introduces a confound: observed differences in calibration error or sharpness may stem from model architecture rather than the uncertainty‑quantification method itself, violating the requirement for a fair comparison of UQ techniques.

FR-004 requires paired statistical tests on “per‑sample error vectors”, yet the only per‑sample quantities defined in the spec are raw prediction errors (in per_sample_errors.csv). Calibration Error and Sharpness, the primary evaluation metrics, are scalar summaries per method‑dataset pair. The spec does not clarify which per‑sample vector will be used, risking an invalid application of Wilcoxon or paired t‑tests to scalar metrics. The methodology must explicitly define a per‑sample statistic (e.g., absolute error, interval width, binary coverage) for the paired tests.
